status: split — folder-per-tab per §5.9/§5.12; growthFromRupture (still in kernel.js, owned by Rupture) now emits growth:seed_requested instead of reaching into this tab's DOM directly — same sovereignty fix as Feelings→Oracle/Poetry. Found and fixed: askQuestion()/answerQuestion() called raw sendP2P({type:'question:new'/'question:answer', loop/answer}) directly, bypassing emitSync's envelope wrapping — loop/answer landed at the top level instead of inside `data`, so the question:new/question:answer gates (shared/eravos-kernel.js) read ev.data.loop as undefined. Confirmed via test: threw on delivery and wrote an undefined entry into eravors_question_loops before throwing. Now uses emitSync, which also restores queue-on-failure for these two message types. Direct request (screenshots comparing this tab against Grammar/Hard Talk): the real logging form used to be hidden behind a '+ Log Growth' toggle button, which made the tab read as an empty box on first view despite having real structured fields underneath. openGrowthForm()/growth-form removed — the form is inline and always visible now, same pattern Grammar/Hard Talk already used. growth-stats (a card grid) replaced with growth-stats-line (a simple count, same pattern as Grammar's '0 shared' / Hard Talk's '0 named · 0 returned to'). qloop-stats-line added for the same reason on the question-loops section.
